$description: BATHONG. design tokens - source of truth. tokens/tokens.css is the hand-maintained CSS mirror of this file; keep the two in sync. Values come from the brand brief v1.0 (28 Jul 2026) and are not up for casual revision.

ink.description: Near-black. The darkroom. Text on paper, ink surfaces, the 2px frame border.

paper.description: Warm off-white. The print. Default page background.

jacaranda.description: Pretoria in October. The identity colour. The punch-dot, section accents, one full-bleed section per page at most.

jacaranda-deep.description: Deep variant. Links, hover states, small type on paper where #7B5CD6 lacks contrast.

signal.description: Highveld flash. Accent only: tags, highlights, the member CTA, selection. Never a background for long text.

ratio.description: Rough surface budget per page. Signal is punctuation, not paint.

display.description: Display. Always uppercase, tracking -0.03em, leading 0.9. The wordmark is set in nothing else, ever.

mono.description: The editorial furniture: captions, labels, metadata, dictionary entries, tickers. This layer is what makes the system read as contact sheets and archive cards.

mark.description: The wordmark. Hero and footer only.

display-1.description: Section titles. End with the punch-dot.

frame-width.description: The ink border. On every photograph, card and field.

shadow-print.description: Hard offset, like a print stacked on another print. Ink on paper sections, jacaranda under the member card.

radius.description: Nothing is rounded. Prints have corners.

grain.value: SVG fractalNoise, baseFrequency 0.9, alpha 0.05, overlay opacity 0.5
grain.description: Fine film grain fixed over everything digital. Unifies mixed member imagery. Implemented as .grain in tokens.css.
